calleo.intro: Calleo is a family-run audio guest book company. Guests pick up a retro-style telephone, hear a recorded greeting and leave a voicemail, which Calleo edits into a keepsake recording. They cover weddings in England, Scotland and Wales, plus destination weddings.
about: Calleo offers an alternative to the written guest book. Instead of signing a page, guests pick up a retro-style telephone, listen to a recorded greeting and leave a voicemail. Calleo suggests it for weddings, birthdays and any celebration. It covers weddings in England, Scotland and Wales, as well as destination weddings abroad, but cannot ship to Northern Ireland.

The business was founded by Bailey and Rob. Calleo says the idea came after Rob's grandfather, Bob Langley, died in 2021: Rob wished he could hear his grandfather's voice once more, which his handwritten guest book entry could not capture. Calleo describes itself as family-run. Bailey's parents, Sarah and Phil, handle the admin and prepare each phone once a booking is made. Calleo is a trading name of B R Ventures Ltd.

Booking starts with an availability form. Customers then choose a phone and package and pay in full by debit or credit card or Klarna. A welcome pack follows, and customers record a custom greeting, though the CORE package excludes a personalised greeting. The phone arrives by courier two days before the event. It needs no Wi-Fi or landline, only a standard 13 amp socket, and Calleo recommends placing it at least five metres from bands, DJs or speakers.

Calleo says it listens to and edits every voicemail. After the event, the phone is returned at a post office (the ELEGANT package includes collection by Calleo staff). Customers review a first-draft MP3 in an online gallery and can request changes within their package's allowance before approving any USB, vinyl record or video memory book. Calleo's company policies page links its public liability insurance and PAT certificates. Its homepage displays a 2024 Wedding Industry Awards regional winner badge.

cj-sax.tagline: Based in London, creating vibes worldwide…
cj-sax.intro: CJ SAX LIVE is the business of CJ, a London-based saxophonist, DJ and event planner. He offers live sax and sax-and-DJ sets for weddings, corporate events and parties in the UK and abroad, and recommends and coordinates other live performers.
about: CJ SAX LIVE is the act and events business of CJ, who describes himself as a saxophonist, DJ and event planner based in London. His website offers wedding, corporate event and party hire, and the site's name describes wedding sax and DJ work in London alongside event planning and entertainment in Essex. Under the line 'Based in London, creating vibes worldwide…', its Destinations section highlights Ibiza (Ushuaia), the Amalfi Coast (Villa Cimbrone), D'Maris Bay (Nusr'et Restaurant) and Cape Town (MolenVliet Vineyard).

His website and press pack say CJ has performed at the London 2012 Olympics and at the Abu Dhabi and Monaco F1 Grand Prix. They also name venues such as The O2, the Tower of London, The Dorchester and Ronnie Scott's, along with performances in Ibiza, Dubai, Marbella, Cannes and Mallorca. According to the press pack, he launched his own events company and works with high-profile clients, and the business says it has provided event services for over a decade.

Planners can book CJ to play sax alongside their own DJ, or as a combined sax-and-DJ act that brings his own sound system and lighting. His DJ sets are open format and aim to read the crowd, running from 70s and 80s soul through club classics, house, dance anthems, old-school RnB and garage. The business also recommends performers from its network, such as DJs, bongo players, violinists and a magician, and helps coordinate them.

CJ's own packages include public liability insurance, an event contract and invoice, and WhatsApp support. His pricing calendar treats May to September (worldwide) and November to December (London) as peak periods. January to April and October (Dubai and London) are off-peak, and discounted off-peak prices are available on enquiry, subject to availability.

grape-fig.tagline: THE HOME OF 100% BRITISH, ARTISAN CHEESE & CHARCUTERIE, STYLED BEAUTIFULLY
grape-fig.intro: GRAPE & Fig is a sister-run grazing company based in Romford. They make sharing platters, grazing tables and on-site food displays centred on 100% British cheese and charcuterie, with ready-to-eat orders hand-delivered to most of the M25 area and Essex.
about: GRAPE & Fig is run by sisters Toria and Catherine. Toria Smith founded the company in 2017. While planning her own wedding the year before, she had wanted a four-metre grazing table to serve as canapés and starters combined. The business says it brought the concept of 'grazing' to the UK from Australia, and Catherine joined in spring 2019. Together they make sharing platters, grazing tables and styled food displays for gatherings, celebrations and brand events.

Since the start of 2022 they have used only 100% British cheese and charcuterie, sourced from small dairy farms and independent artisan producers across the UK. Every cheese or charcuterie-based platter comes with a menu and a map showing where the produce is from. The business says everything is handmade each morning in its kitchens with locally sourced, seasonal produce. The team are also trained florists and combine food and flowers in their displays.

Their own same-day, fragile-goods courier service hand-delivers ready-to-eat orders to most of the M25 area and Essex, Tuesday to Saturday. Orders can also be collected from their HQ in Romford. A £130 minimum spend applies for hand-delivery. They prefer as much notice as possible but need only 48 hours for last-minute orders, though days can close once capacity is reached. Selected gift boxes, kits and hampers ship overnight to most of mainland UK.

In 2024 the business opened what it calls the UK's first 'Build Your Own British Cheese Box Bar' on London's Regent Street. At the April 2024 launch, customers chose a box size and a base of cheese, charcuterie or vegan cheese, added condiments and built the box alongside the team. Its website advertises the bar as a seasonal summer pop-up at Brityard, 285 Regent Street.

harry-de-cruz.tagline: Modern Magic, designed to be remembered.
harry-de-cruz.intro: Harry De Cruz is a magician, mind reader and event host based in London and New York. He offers close-up, stage and wedding magic, parlour shows and compèring for corporate events, product launches, private parties and weddings.
about: Harry De Cruz is a magician, mind reader and event host who describes himself as an award-winning London magician. He combines a background in stand-up comedy with technical sleight of hand and mentalism, and performs in a relaxed, conversational style. He says he is based in London and New York and available worldwide, and that he has worked in more than 30 countries, from product launches in the United States to private dinners across Europe and celebrations in the Maldives.

Harry says he has performed at hundreds of weddings and plans the timing of the magic with each couple, whether that means mingling at the drinks reception, going from table to table at the wedding breakfast or performing in the evening. He says he has over 15 years of experience performing at events. Before clients book, he offers to meet them for a coffee or over Zoom, free of charge, and show them some magic.

Alongside his event work, he says he co-wrote and performs in the magic show AMAZE at New World Stages in New York. His homepage also lists Wonderville at The Palace Theatre in London's West End and Champions of Magic at the Boulevard Theatre among his theatre shows, without saying whether those runs are current. Behind the scenes, he works as a creative advisor, writer and designer for magicians and theatre shows. The credits he lists include Magic Director and Resident Director on Derren Brown's Unbelievable, and 'the better part of a decade' with Dynamo, including as Head of Magic.

His website says he was awarded London Magician of the Year in 2024, 2025 and 2026. A 2022 profile in Absolutely Magazine describes him as born and raised in Buckinghamshire, says he joined The Magic Circle at 18 and names him as an Associate of the Inner Magic Circle.

jamie-roche.intro: Jamie Roche is an Irish-born, London-based singer/songwriter. He performs on guitar and vocals, mixing his own songs with folk songs and covers, with a style described as heavily influenced by artists such as Ray LaMontagne and Van Morrison.
about: Jamie Roche is an Irish-born singer/songwriter who grew up in North London and is based in London. His style of music is described as heavily influenced by artists such as Ray LaMontagne and Van Morrison. He performs on guitar and vocals, and his filmed performances move between his own songs, folk songs and covers.

His own songs include 'The Tide', with lyrics by Jamie Roche and Luke Carey. A live performance of it filmed at Painter Studios in London was shared in 2019, and 'The Tide (Acoustic)' was released in September 2022 on Orange Tree Records. 'Play The Fool', released on 23 October 2026 and also on Orange Tree Records, credits Jamie on vocals with Kealan Kenny as studio producer.

His YouTube channel gathers live performances filmed around London. They include Eric Bogle's 'The Green Fields of France' at St Mary Magdalene Church, Enfield, with Eilish Byrne-Whelehan on violin; Ray LaMontagne's 'Such a Simple Thing' at St John's Church, Hoxton; Chris Isaak's 'Wicked Game' at Sixty Sixty Sounds in Soho; and Fleetwood Mac's 'Dreams' at the Chinese Pagoda in Victoria Park, Hackney. Together they give a clear sense of his sound before an enquiry.

lucy-jane-cakes.intro: Lucy Jane Cakes is a cake maker whose TikTok bio gives London as its base, with some videos tagged for Essex. PEOPLE has called the baker behind it a buttercream specialist. Its videos show heart, character, photo and bento cakes; orders are by Instagram message.
about: The TikTok bio for Lucy Jane Cakes gives London as its location. In February 2025 PEOPLE referred to 'the buttercream specialist behind Lucy Jane Cakes' and reported that she had baked her entire life and began selling cakes professionally in 2016. Her video captions use hashtags for both London and Essex, including #londoncakes, #lambethcake, #southwoodford and #essexcakes.

The same article reported that she made seven cakes for her own wedding in London on 7 December 2024. The main cake was a three-tier classic vanilla sponge, the other six were each a different flavour, and all seven were finished two days before the wedding. She also told the story of making them in a TikTok video.

Alongside finished cakes, the TikTok account @lucy_jane_cakes has posted baking and decorating how-to videos. These include a photo-cake tutorial that names the Wilton 199 and Jen 2ES nozzles she used, along with tips on getting a level rise in 6-inch PME tins and on freezing leftover cake slices.

Lucy Jane Cakes does not appear to have its own website and publishes no prices. Its TikTok bio reads 'Lucy Jane Cakes / London / Message on Instagram for orders', so enquiries about a cake for an event go by direct message to @lucy_jane_cakes on Instagram.

magpie-catering.intro: Magpie Catering is an events catering company based in Hastingwood, Essex, serving the South East of England. They cater weddings, corporate functions, private dinners and celebrations at venues, marquees and homes, with menus from canapés and bowl food to seated meals, BBQs and Turkish-inspired mezze.
about: Based in Hastingwood, Essex, Magpie Catering describes itself as a professional events catering service for the South East of England. Managing Director Elizabeth Joyce says the business grew out of a restaurant she part-owned with her father, and that she started by catering small weddings and events such as funerals. The business names her restaurant as The Magpies Nest Restaurant in Epping. They now cater at any venue, marquee or private home, for occasions ranging from weddings and corporate functions to birthdays, christenings and funerals.

Their service ranges from delivered buffets to fully staffed, managed events, and they bring all the catering equipment needed. Seated menus include qualified chefs, a personal events manager, trained waiting staff, cutlery, china and table laying. Waiting staff are trained in-house and work in uniform. Weddings and larger events are offered a tasting beforehand, and regular corporate clients can ask for a sample buffet.

They describe their menus as globally influenced, drawing on English, Asian, Italian and French cooking with a modern approach, and say they research new products at trade and food shows to keep up with trends. Styles run from canapés and bowl food to finger and fork buffets, seated meals, BBQs, Turkish-inspired mezze and private fine dining, with gluten- and dairy-free options on several menus.

Case studies on their website include the Alleyn Court Preparatory School Summer Ball 2010 in Southend-on-Sea, with a champagne and canapé reception and a three-course dinner for 224 guests; marquee weddings, one of them at Ingatestone Hall; a seated wedding at Sutton Hall Farm, Rochford; and a 2009 venue-opening lunch in Beaconsfield, where canapés and bowl food were served to 170 guests.

meatstop.intro: Meat Stop is an Essex-born burger business offering BBQ and burger catering for weddings, corporate events and parties across Essex. Its website also lists two London locations: The Commercial Tavern in Shoreditch and Hand of Glory in Dalston.
about: Meat Stop describes itself as 'Essex-born. London-serving. Premium fast food.' The business explains that its line 'fast food, upgraded.' means better ingredients, in-house recipes and custom-spec brioche buns rather than bigger portions. It says it keeps the menu tight, cooks everything fresh and uses dry-aged beef farmed in its home county of Essex, ground fresh for its burgers.

For events, Meat Stop says it has gone 'back to our roots; the garden BBQ', catering 'from weddings, to corporate, to a good old party'. It says it has over 20 years of experience in catering, event planning and preparing food, and offers to do the heavy lifting so hosts can sit back and enjoy their event. Its catering page names towns across Essex, including Colchester, Chelmsford, Southend, Basildon, Billericay, Epping and Maldon, and invites enquiries for an accurate quote.

The business has its roots in Brentwood, Essex. In 2015 its website described Meat Stop as Brentwood's only boutique burger bar, serving dine-in and takeaway from Crown Street, and named Benjamin as its chef and founder. Its website now lists two London locations: The Commercial Tavern in Shoreditch and Hand of Glory in Dalston. A Burger Dudes review published in July 2026 reports that Meat Stop opened at The Commercial Tavern by the end of 2025, and that the reviewers tried its burgers at Burger Fest UK 2026.

natalie-max.intro: Natalie & Max Photo and Films is a husband-and-wife wedding photography and videography duo based in Ware, Hertfordshire. They cover weddings from preparations to party, across Hertfordshire, Essex and the wider UK as well as destination weddings abroad.
about: Natalie and Max met at university, where they studied photography and design. They say they started photographing weddings together in 2012, the year they set up Natalie & Max Photo and Films. After graduating they moved to the Algarve to live and work, and from then on covered both UK and destination weddings. They now describe themselves as a British duo who spend half the year in the UK and the rest in the Algarve, where they married in 2022.

Their aim is to blend in like 'one of the guests', and they sum up what they do as 'Two guests with great cameras'. Coverage runs from prep to party: they usually arrive at bridal preparations about two hours before the couple leaves for the ceremony, and stay until around 30 minutes after the first dance. Photographs are delivered within four to six weeks and films within six to eight weeks, through a private online gallery.

They say they take a maximum of 35 weddings a year, including destination weddings, and that couples usually book 12 to 18 months ahead. Their terms ask for a non-refundable 30% deposit to secure a date, and UK travel beyond 30 miles of Ware is charged at £1 per mile. Alongside weddings they shoot fashion and editorial work; their editorial page says they are the official photographers and videographers for wedding dress designers Ivory & Co and Dress Me Pretty.

ozzy-stix.intro: Ozzy&Stix is an Essex-based duo: a vocalist and a guitarist who both also play bongos and percussion. They offer acoustic sets and party sets for weddings and parties. Both members also DJ, and they can add a sax, violin or trumpet.
about: Ozzy&Stix pairs a vocalist with a guitarist, and both members also play bongos and percussion. Their website says they suit acoustic performances at an event, a party set, or both. The site is focused on weddings, under the line 'We Create The Best Memories on Your Big Day'. The contact page places them in Essex, and the site's own description and 'LDN' logo also present them as a London duo.

Both members also DJ, and they say they are comfortable with Jewish dancing, Bhangra and plenty of other genres that may come up at weddings. Through their #MADE offer, clients can add a sax, violin or trumpet, and their FAQ says further musicians and singers are available from their own books. They say they can provide music and entertainment from the ceremony through to the full party. They will also perform alongside other acts, including external DJs, if they feel the combination will work well.

They build sets from a guide to what the crowd enjoys. They will learn specific songs within reason, and ask for at least six weeks' notice for a first dance or ceremony song. They are happy to remove songs connected to bad memories. PAT test and public liability documents, and a repertoire list, are available on request. They do not provide lighting but may be able to suggest a supplier. They will travel abroad, and the client pays flights, accommodation and transfers on top of the fee.

Previous clients named on their website include the V&A Museum London, Deutsche Bank, Just Seventy Events, London Rox Events, Royal Caribbean Cruises, Sunseeker Luxury Yachts, BNP Paribas and PHJR Events. They play a few public gigs each year and announce the dates on Instagram. Their YouTube channel has acoustic covers, mashups and an 'O&S Presents' session series, which give a feel for their sound.

paint-and-pour.intro: Paint & Pour runs guided sip-and-paint nights in Epping and Chingford. Its founder, Bryony, guides guests through a painting step by step, with no experience needed. Each guest gets a drink on arrival, all materials are supplied and everyone takes their finished canvas home.
about: Paint & Pour runs guided paint-and-wine evenings in Epping and Chingford, led by its founder, Bryony. She says she started it with a simple idea: most people haven't picked up a paintbrush since school, and they really should, preferably with a glass of wine in the other hand. No experience is needed, and guests can come with friends, with a date or on their own.

Each night is a three-hour guided session. Guests arrive, get a drink and find an easel. Bryony then takes them through the painting one step at a time, with music playing. Canvas, paints, brushes and aprons are all provided, and a complimentary drink is included on arrival. The evening ends with a 'Mini Gallery & Photo Time', and everyone takes their painting home.

Public nights take place at Carpino Lounge on Epping High Street and at The Royal Forest on Ranger's Road, Chingford. Tickets for the currently listed nights are sold through Eventbrite at £35 each. Doors open at 6:40pm, with check-in at 7pm and painting from 7:30pm. Under-18s must come with a parent or legal guardian. Tickets are non-refundable, but Bryony offers a transfer to an event on another date.

The organiser says the events usually sell out and suggests following their Eventbrite page to hear about new dates first. Their public pages do not describe private or exclusive bookings, so anyone planning a group occasion should ask them directly, through Eventbrite or Instagram, about availability and format.

ray-johnson.tagline: Bringing the magic of Elton John to your event
ray-johnson.intro: Ray Elton Johnson is an Essex-based Elton John tribute act, lookalike and singer. He performs at weddings, private parties and corporate events across East London, Essex, Kent, Hertfordshire and the M25 area, and has appeared as Elton on television and in film.
about: Ray Elton Johnson, also known as Elton Ray Johnson, is an Elton John tribute act, lookalike and singer, and his site says he has been doing it for 30 years. He is based in Essex: his site gives Theydon Bois on the homepage and Chigwell on the contact page. He covers East London, Essex, Kent, Hertfordshire and the M25 area, and says he is available for events 'from intimate pub gigs to grand weddings', with customisable performances.

His television career began on an ITV series about the Derek's Doubles lookalike agency. His site says the series was sold to 39 countries, and afterwards he performed in New Zealand and several European countries. He has since appeared on programmes including Ant & Dec's Saturday Night Takeaway, That Peter Kay Thing, Have I Got News For You, The Weakest Link, Jimmy Carr's Big Fat Wedding and Big Fat Quiz of Everything. He also took part in LadBaby's 2022 Christmas No. 1.

His About page says he has appeared as Elton John in five films and names the French comedy God Save The Tuche (2025) as the latest. His site shares photos from the set in Lille. He also body-doubled for Elton on the set of Charlotte Tilbury's 2023 Christmas promo. His gallery mentions an appearance at An Evening with Chris Moyles and Dominic Byrne at the London Palladium in January 2026, as well as a performance at Firs Park Resort in Essex.

As well as his own shows, he plays a duo set in pubs and clubs with Nigel Silk, a drummer from the tribute band T Rexasy. He has also started George 'n' Elton, a combined George Michael and Elton John tribute that opened at the Comrades Club in Clacton-on-Sea. His FAQ recommends booking at least three months ahead, and clients can choose their favourite Elton John songs for the setlist.

the-bar-people.intro: The Bar People is a London-based mobile bar company serving events nationwide. They offer all-inclusive, dry hire and cash bars, staff hire and event management for corporate events, weddings, private parties and festivals.
about: The Bar People is a mobile bar company based in London that brings its bespoke bars to events anywhere in the country. Their homepage lists five core services: all-inclusive bars, dry hire, cash bars, staff hire and event management. The business is run by The Bar People Limited (company number 12161824).

Their pop-up bars are modular and can be customised for indoor or outdoor use, in any size or colour, with listed sizes running from 5ft up to a 40ft island. For corporate events they describe more than a decade of experience, offering signature cocktails, branded bar setups and interactive cocktail stations, plus eco-friendly options such as biodegradable straws and locally sourced ingredients. They handle everything from setup to cleanup.

For weddings, they provide bar service for a few hours or the whole day, with custom cocktail menus, themed bar setups, mocktails, and wine and beer stations. Non-alcoholic drinks and mocktails can be added to any package, and all-inclusive packages include setup and takedown. Their cash bars are described as licensed to serve alcohol at any venue and take both cash and card.

Event management is run as a team: Jake Lee looks after corporate events and logistics, and Kim Knight looks after private events and weddings. They recommend booking at least three months ahead, particularly for peak dates, and say they also cater for last-minute events. The 'We've Supported' section of their homepage shows brand logos including Salesforce, Sky, O2, EE and Batiste.

tl-executive-cars.intro: T&L Executive Cars is a private hire and chauffeur car service based in Theydon Bois, Essex. They provide wedding transport and guest transfers, corporate and special-event travel, and airport and cruise terminal transfers in a fleet that includes Mercedes E, S and V Class vehicles.
about: T&L Executive Cars, also known as Theydon and Loughton Executive Cars, is a private hire car service based in Theydon Bois. The founder writes that he set the business up in 2008 to serve local individuals and businesses, and that he personally guarantees the service to every customer. They say the business was built on a professional, prompt and reliable service, and that over the years many of their clients have come to them through personal recommendation.

They describe themselves as an alternative, affordable car service for local individuals, small businesses and corporate clients, including several multinational companies. The fleet listed on their website is a Mercedes E Class and a Mercedes S Class (each for four passengers and three bags), a Mercedes V Class (seven passengers, seven bags) and a 'Toureno Custom Executive Spec' vehicle for eight passengers and eight bags.

For weddings, they can provide anything from a single car to the venue to a small fleet, and they also run a guest logistics service between hotels and the venue. They say their vehicles are licensed and inspected by Epping Forest District Council and certificated as exempt from displaying a private hire plate, so journeys can be discreet. They describe their drivers as smart and polite.

They serve Theydon Bois, Loughton, Epping, Abridge, Ongar, Buckhurst Hill, Chigwell and Woodford Green, with transfers to all London airports and to a number of seaports and cruise terminals. Their listed hours are Monday to Friday, 9.00am to 6.30pm, and they say they reply within 24 hours. Quotes can be requested through an online form on their website, and accepted payment methods include Visa, MasterCard, American Express and Apple Pay.

about: TM Event Hire is a marquee and event equipment hire company based in Barnston, Dunmow, in Essex. According to the business, director Thomas Mclean founded it in 2013, initially specialising in catering equipment, tableware and glassware hire, and it previously traded as TM Catering Hire. His younger brother Michael Mclean joined in 2014 and became joint owner and chief of operations: Thomas looks after sales and customers, while Michael makes sure events are organised and equipment arrives on time.

Today the range runs from clear-span and Chinese hat marquees to mobile bars, furniture, kitchen equipment and tableware, for weddings, private and public events, corporate functions, birthdays and more. The team delivers, sets up, de-rigs and collects across Essex, London and Hertfordshire, seven days a week, and says its prices include delivery, setup and pickup. They describe themselves as a member of the Event Hire Association with over 10 years of experience in the events, catering and wedding industries.

For marquees, the process starts with a site visit, and a 25% non-refundable deposit secures the booking. Equipment is installed one to three days before the event and collected the day after. tony-poole-discos.intro: Tony Poole Discos is a team of wedding, party and corporate event DJs based in Theydon Bois, Essex. As well as mobile discos, they supply uplighting, LED dance floors, backdrops, light-up LOVE letters, and photo and 360 video booths across Essex, Herts, London and beyond.
about: Tony Poole Discos describes itself as a team of experienced, versatile DJs who personalise each occasion, mixing requests with tracks they know will work. The business says it has been in the DJ industry for over 30 years and plays at venues across London and the Home Counties. Its DJs page lists a team of 20, including Tony Poole and Richard Poole.

Music is tailored to each event. Before the day, clients are asked to send the tracks and genres they want played, plus a list of tracks or types of music they don't want played. On the night, the DJ reads the room and does their best to work in guests' requests. According to the business, every booking comes with an experienced DJ who co-ordinates and comperes moments such as the First Dance, a surprise entrance, announcements and introductions.

Beyond the music, they can dress a venue with ambience uplighting, white LED dance floors, starlit backdrops and giant light-up LOVE letters and numbers. They can also add photo or 360 video booths and confetti bombs, and arrange live entertainment. The business states that its sound and lighting equipment is PAT tested and complies with health and safety rules, and that it holds Public Liability Insurance. It also says it has backup DJs and breakdown cover on its vehicles in case of emergencies.

They say they have played at London venues including Buckingham Palace, Grosvenor House, The Dorchester, The Ritz and The Shard. To book, event details go onto a reservation form, which the client confirms by email. A 25% deposit is generally due within 14 days. The balance is paid on the night by cash or cheque, or in advance by BACS. Deposits are normally non-refundable but can be moved to another event.

toot-sweet-candy-cart.intro: Toot Sweet Candy Cart is a candy cart hire business based in Chelmsford, Essex. They hire out a handmade Victorian candy cart, dressed with sweets and decorations, and offer a variety of sweet packages.
about: Toot Sweet Candy Cart describes itself as a candy cart hire business in Chelmsford, Essex. They hire out their handmade Victorian candy cart and offer a variety of sweet packages to go with it. The cart is white, with spoked wheels and the business name painted on the front panel. Their round grey logo shows an illustrated cart and carries the words 'EST 2020', and their X account dates from March 2020.

Photos of the cart show it dressed with balloon garlands, bunting, flowers, cakes, doughnuts and jars of sweets. In June 2020 they restyled the cart as a brunch and afternoon-tea display, saying they had 'tried something a little different with the Candy Cart'. The display had a Victoria sponge, scones, sandwiches, watermelon, champagne, flowers, a balloon garland and a personalised 'On Weekends We Brunch' sign.

In June 2020 the business also made personalised sweet boxes. Each held 12 different sweets and Ferrero Rochers and came with a choice of colour theme and a personalised gift tag and message. The boxes were posted out, and free delivery was offered around Chelmsford and Ingatestone at the time. Their most recent visible public posts date from June 2020, so planners should check current availability, packages and pricing directly with the business, for example through their Facebook page.
